question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing right winger, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing left back, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing right back, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) right winger
(C) right midfielder
(D) left back
(E) benchwarmer
(F) right back
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Positions in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (cheerleader, right winger, right midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right back, goalkeeper)
1. Claire swaps with Dave: (cheerleader, right winger, left back, right midfielder, benchwarmer, right back, goalkeeper)
2. Dave swaps with Bob: (cheerleader, right midfielder, left back, right winger, benchwarmer, right back, goalkeeper)
3. Eve swaps with Dave: (cheerleader, right midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right winger, right back, goalkeeper)
4. Alice swaps with Fred: (right back, right midfielder, left back, benchwarmer, right winger, cheerleader, goalkeeper)
5. Dave swaps with Eve: (right back, right midfielder, left back, right winger, benchwarmer, cheerleader, goalkeeper)
6. Eve swaps with Bob: (right back, benchwarmer, left back, right winger, right midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper)
7. Alice swaps with Claire: (left back, benchwarmer, right back, right winger, right midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper)
Alice plays left back, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
